title: Streak Programs
emptyActiveBody: Activate a streak program to start rewarding daily visitors.
emptyUpcomingBody: Create and publish a program so users can see it's coming.
emptyEndedBody: Ended streak programs will appear here.
upcomingExistsMessage: There is already an upcoming streak program for this store. End or activate it first before publishing another one.
activeExistsMessage: There is already an active streak program for this store. End it before activating this one, or set an activation schedule to queue this program as upcoming.
publishMessage: Users will be able to see this program is coming. You can activate it when you're ready.
publishMessageNoScheduleLive: No start date is set. This program will go live for earning immediately (you won’t need a separate activate step), as long as no other program is active.
publishMessageNoScheduleQueued: No activation schedule is set. If another streak is still active, this program will become upcoming and start after that one ends; otherwise it goes live for earning immediately.
activateMessage: Earning will start now for customers (scheduled start time will be ignored). Continue?
upcomingBannerScheduled: Visible to customers. Auto-starts on {{date}}. Tap Activate to start earning immediately instead.
upcomingBannerFlexible: Visible to customers. Tap Activate when you're ready for earning to begin.
endMessage: This will immediately stop earning for all users. This action cannot be undone.
deleteMessage: This will permanently delete this program. This action cannot be undone.
